excludedServers.gemini-api-docs-mcp: Repeated HTTP 429 responses cause background reconnect churn in Cursor; retain for explicit on-demand clients.

includedLocalServers.facebook-ads: Meta Ads MCP requires a USER token with ads_mcp_management. Cursor OAuth loopback is unreliable against Meta's localhost→127.0.0.1 rewrite, so this uses mcp-remote + META_APP_USER_TOKEN via run-server.
includedLocalServers.data-manager-mcp: No official hosted Google Data Manager MCP exists. Lean local read-only diagnostics for request status and auth.
